Now I have everything I need. Here is the full analysis.

---

## Overclaims in [`docs/bob-usage-statement.md`](docs/bob-usage-statement.md)

---

### 1. Hook name mismatch (§2)

> **"`SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PostToolUse` and `Stop` hooks in `.bob/settings.json` call `origit session start`, `run start`, `trace` and `run end`."**

The statement is almost right, but [`trace.py` line 4](origit/origit/trace.py:4) and [`session.py` lines 9–12](origit/origit/session.py:9) show that **`origit trace` is called on `PostToolUse`** (and on `SessionStart` / `Stop` as bookend events). The statement correctly names all four hooks, so this is fine — but the immediately following sentence says:

> **"The payload carries session id, tool, path and command."**

`positioning.md §How IBM Bob is actually used` (tracer bullet) says the real payload keys are `hook_event_name`, `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_response`, plus `cwd`, `tool_use_id`, `last_assistant_message`. The statement's paraphrase "session id, tool, path and command" conflates the decoded fields with the raw payload fields. It's slightly misleading.

**Proposed replacement:**
> *"The payload carries the session id, tool name, inputs (path, command) and tool response. When Bob stops, Origit folds the trace, runs the tests and seals the record as a git note."*

---

### 2. Session range — §1 says #42–#44, but #48 and #49 are also cited in the same paragraph

> **"built the payout-export feature across sessions #42–#44, a health endpoint, settlement retry logic (#48) and PAN masking in export logs (#49)."**

`STATUS.md` (02:55 log entry) confirms #48 (retry logic) and #49 (PAN masking) as real sessions in the demo repo. But the range "sessions #42–#44" is also presented as covering the payout-export feature. `STATUS.md` task 6a/6b describe tasks T02–T05 (sessions rooted around the same range) but the health endpoint session is never explicitly labelled in STATUS. The statement presents five distinct features across named sessions as if they are all "Every session has a real, hash-verified Origit record" — which is supportable — but the session numbering implies a continuous arc that is not fully documented in any accessible artifact (`bob_sessions/` is empty on disk). This is an unverifiable specific claim rather than a proven overclaim, but it should be hedged.

**Proposed replacement:**
> *"Bob IDE, in the `origit-build` custom mode (edits limited to `src/**`), built the payout-export feature, a health endpoint, settlement retry logic (#48) and PAN masking in export logs (#49). Every session has a real, hash-verified Origit record."*

*(Drop the "#42–#44" range: `bob_sessions/` is empty and the range cannot be verified by a reader.)*

---

### 3. "fifteen demo commits" — overcounts against documented reality

> **"It reviewed all fifteen demo commits"**

`STATUS.md` log (03:50, 04:15) is explicit: **17 demo commits, 17 records, 17/17 with Bob evidence.** "Fifteen" is simply the wrong number.

**Proposed replacement:**
> *"It reviewed all seventeen demo commits;"*

---

### 4. "seven commits … in three tool calls" — unverifiable specific

> **"Bob answered with seven commits, session labels, first-read time and roll-back commit in three tool calls."**

`bob_sessions/` contains no JSON files on disk, so this exact count cannot be grounded in any file in the repo. `positioning.md §Claims discipline` prohibits saying things that cannot be evidenced. This is a concrete demonstration claim that should either be sourced or generalised.

**Proposed replacement:**
> *"Bob answered with the affected commits, session labels, first-read time and roll-back commit in a small number of tool calls."*

---

### 5. Bobcoin figures — internally inconsistent

> **"About 12 of Tim's 40 Bobcoins went on build and demo runs"**

`STATUS.md` (03:40 log) says **"Roughly 33 coins left before the video"** after spending roughly 2.8 (tasks 10–16) + 1.3 (console reviews) + 0.1 (Art. 14) = **≈4.2 coins** on Sunday tasks, on top of 3.9 (IDE tasks T01–T06) + 0.08 (T07) + estimated ~8.8 (B01 statements) + 0.15 (B03) + ~1.1 (J04) on Saturday. The total spend implied is well above 12 and the starting balance is described as "~37 left" (Saturday afternoon) not "40 total." Neither "40 Bobcoins" nor "12 spent" is consistent with the ledger.

**Proposed replacement:**
> *"The majority of Tim's Bobcoins went on build and demo runs; the rest is reserved for the recorded demo and the teammates' IDE tasks."*

---

### Summary table

| # | Quoted claim | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | *"The payload carries session id, tool, path and command."* | Paraphrases raw hook keys inaccurately | Replace with the actual decoded fields per STATUS.md |
| 2 | *"sessions #42–#44"* | `bob_sessions/` is empty; range unverifiable | Drop the specific range |
| 3 | *"all fifteen demo commits"* | STATUS.md records 17/17 | Replace with "seventeen" |
| 4 | *"seven commits … in three tool calls"* | No JSON on disk to support the exact counts | Generalise |
| 5 | *"About 12 of Tim's 40 Bobcoins"* | Inconsistent with the coin ledger in STATUS.md | Replace with a non-specific description |
